question: What is Sarasvati city and who dwells there?
premises: Sarasvati city is the abode of knowers of sound-Brahman.
Those suitable to Rudra are situated there.
Others are situated apart from Rudras due to primacy.
inference: Sarasvati city houses knowers of sound-Brahman and Rudra-suitable beings.
plain_english: Sarasvati city is the abode of knowers of sound-Brahman; those suitable to Rudra are situated there, while others stand apart from Rudras due to primacy.
